info.title: Tico API (v2)
info.description: The stable API for building your own frontend on Tico. Everything here keeps its shape within v2: fields are added, never removed or renamed, and a breaking change is a new /api/v3. Routes not listed are internal. Granola connection and sync writes do not require an idempotency key, nor does POST /api/v2/inbound/tasks, whose own `key` is its idempotency. Other writes need an `Idempotency-Key` header (1-200 characters; a retry with the same key and body returns the first answer). Errors are `{"error": {code, detail, retryable}}`. See docs/custom-frontend.md.

GroupUpdate.title: GroupUpdate
GroupUpdate.description:
Rename a group, move it under another (`parent`; "" = top level), and add or remove teammates. A teammate
added to a group leaves the one it was in.

storage.description: Read-only file storage usage and copy progress; Team owners only

InboundTask.title: InboundTask
InboundTask.description:
What one piece of another system's work should look like now (POST /api/v2/inbound/tasks).
`owner`, `title` and `body` are needed only when the call files the task; anything left out
stays as it is.

id.description: A UUID, or auto:<bot>:<metric> for a bot's automatic KPI

freshness.description: stale: one period missed; missing: never read or two missed. Never zero

status.description: Against the target on the link (or a range); gray is stale or missing data; none is fresh with no target

expected.description: Where the straight line from baseline to target is now

items.description: version, ts, actor, name, definition, unit, direction, cadence, source_note; newest first

superseded_by.description: The reading that corrected this one, if any

from_name.description: Display name of from_actor, when it is a person or a bot

body_raw.description: A notice Tico wrote, as stored (with actor ids); `body` shows names to people

edited_at.description: When the author last changed a task comment's text; null when never edited

deleted_at.description: When the author deleted a task comment. A delete or retry acknowledgment can include a tombstone with an empty body; deleted comments are never listed

run.description: The run that handled this message, once one has: on a person's message `{job_id, attempt_id, state}` where `state` is `started_run` (it started the run) or `added_to_run` (it was folded into a run already working); on a bot's reply `{job_id, attempt_id}` (the run that wrote it, plus a summary of what it did). Absent until a run takes the message

answers.description: On a structured ask: all review answers, oldest first. On a bot reply: handled message ids

actors.description: On reads: display names for every actor id in the answer, {"human:ana": "Ana Alvarez"}

PersonalTokenCreate.description:
A personal API token (backend/personal_tokens.py): a label to tell it apart in the list
and how long it lives; 90 days unless asked, never more than a year.

sign_in.description: On a 401 with built-in sign-in: the login path

ServiceKeyCreate.title: ServiceKeyCreate
ServiceKeyCreate.description:
A service key (backend/service_keys.py): the label names the system that holds it, on every
task it files.

execution.description: The latest run: state, label, text (the reply so far; separate messages are joined by a blank line), parts, bot

body.description: Left out of a list asked for with brief=true, as is acceptance_criteria

owner_name.description: Display name of owner (`owner` stays the actor id)

open_asks.description: Questions on this task with no answer or dismissal

number.description: The task's number, unique across the team (#18945); given once on a numbered type and never changed

step_rank.description: Its place within its step, lower first

ToolRegister.description:
A tool a person registers for a bot (backend/bot_tools.py). Names and verbs only: `env` is the
variable's name, and the server refuses a field that looks like a credential.

ToolUpdate.title: ToolUpdate
ToolUpdate.description:
A change to a tool a bot already declares (backend/bot_tools.py): only what is sent changes. `scope` keys
are set one by one (an empty value takes a key off); `note` "" clears the note.

meetings_pending.description: Pending meetings filed for the caller; never part of Needs you

prices_as_of.description: The date the price table was read

items.description: By bot: bot, name, department; by day: day; by routine: routine (null for runs that came from none), title, bot, name. Every row has the usage figures and `share`, its part of the total (estimate plus API-equivalent)

dimensions.description: Available dimension filters, scoped to visible runs

dimension_labels.description: Display labels keyed by immutable filter value; subscription names include their Computer

cached_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache

est_cost_usd.description: List-price estimate for runs billed by API key; null when every such run used a model with no list price

subscription_equiv_usd.description: What runs on a ChatGPT or Claude sign-in would cost through the API: not money spent, never added to est_cost_usd

unpriced_runs.description: Runs with tokens on a model with no list price

source.description: Where each cap comes from: bot, company or null

percent.description: The highest share of a limit reached

blocked.description: Set while a limit is met: the bot takes no new job

bearer.description: A bearer session from POST /auth/token (browser apps) or a personal API token (servers).

serviceKey.description: A service key, tico_sk_..., which reaches POST /api/v2/inbound/tasks and nothing else.

cookie.name: tico_session
